# netbox_virtual_circuit_type (Resource)

Manages a NetBox virtual circuit type (`/api/circuits/virtual-circuit-types/`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_virtual_circuit_type" "example" {
  name        = "L2VPN"
  slug        = "l2vpn"
  color       = "9c27b0"
  description = "Point-to-point Ethernet pseudowires"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name.
- `slug` (String) Slug.

### Optional

- `color` (String) Color. Defaults to an empty string.
- `comments` (String) Comments. Defaults to an empty string.
- `custom_fields` (String) Custom field values as a JSON object (`jsonencode({...})`). Only keys present in the configuration are tracked.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to an empty string.
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to an empty set.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Created.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `url` (String) Url.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# netbox_virtual_circuit_type can be imported by its NetBox object ID.
terraform import netbox_virtual_circuit_type.example 2
```
